snippet.title: We Made the CRAZIEST VR Parkour Game (and it’s FREE)
snippet.description:
We made the craziest VR parkour game – and it’s finally here!

🕹️ Download Magnetic Me FREE on Meta Quest:
👉 https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/magnetic-me/9577590078954461

In Magnetic Me, your hands are magnets. 🔴 Repel, 🔵 Attract, and parkour your way through insane player-made obstacle courses. Swing, fly, throw your friends off maps, or help them reach the finish. It’s chaos, creativity, and competition all rolled into one VR game.

⚡ In this video, I’m hopping into lobbies with random players and trying out the most fun levels we could find. Expect speedruns, fails, crazy escapes, and a lot of laughs.

✨ What makes Magnetic Me special:
– Multiplayer madness – play, compete, or troll your friends
– Daily challenges & hidden rewards
– In-game map editor to build your own wild levels
– Tons of cosmetics to customize your robot
– And yes… we just added PvP battles 🧲💥


💬 Join the Magnetic Me Discord:
👉 https://discord.gg/wvXMXJPk

If you enjoy the video, don’t forget to hit like, subscribe, and drop a comment — it helps us a TON as we grow this game. ❤️
